blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alternergy Holdings Corp., a listed renewable energy producer, is allocating P26 billion in capital expenditures (capex) next year. Gerry Magbanua, president of Alternergy, announced that the group has initiated discussions with lenders to secure financing for its capital expenditures, aimed at deploying two solar projects and one wind facility. READ: Alternergy’s P6.7-B Quezon wind farm goes online These projects have a combined potential capacity of around 320 megawatts (MW), the official noted.
